notes.title: Patch v.05
notes.notes:
[h3]Small patch for the last update[/h3]
[b]New items:[/b]
Handmade Hatchet: a craftable hatchet in case the starting hatchet breaks, not really durable.

[b]New structures:[/b]
Rudimentary anvil: a handcrafted rock anvil, easier to get at start in case metal is out of the game.

Added a UI element in the inventory and during the game to show a main quest to follow in order to help facilitate the story progression.
[b]
General Fixes:[/b]
The starting hunting hatchet model has been changed.
Fixed a bug in the anvil that would let the player click repair and start the bar progression when no weapon/armor was in slot.
I reworked the crafting panel UI to allow an easier experience in finding items and crafting them.
Fixed a part of the river that was non interactable.

notes.title: ARMOR AND WEAPONS UPDATE
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everybody![/p][p]There is a lot of stuff that has been added to the game with this great update and I could not be more happy with it.[/p][p align="justify"]I have worked really hard since the last patch to fix as many bugs as possible and to [b]expand the game[/b], adding requested features, map extensions, items and new mechanics.[/p][p align="justify"]Thank you everybody for supporting the game and thank you to everyone who tested it, especially @McDonnell Douglas AH-64 Apache in my Discord who helped a lot.[/p][p align="justify"]This is everything added in the game:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="8DAl6hFMnLU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]ARMORS AND WEAPONS UPDATE.[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Armors were finally added to the game as a main new feature.[/p][p align="justify"]Armors can be crafted from the build panel using leather, bones or metal scraps.[/p][p align="justify"]Armors are divided into [b]chest [/b]pieces and [b]head [/b]pieces.[/p][p align="justify"]Each piece has a protection value. When the player wears an armor in the inventory by equipping it in the correct slot the bar in the game panel is filled with the protection amount. Zombies and explosions hit the armor before damaging the player’s health.[/p][p align="justify"]When an armor durability value is at 0 it gets destroyed.[/p][p align="justify"]Armors can be repaired using the [b]anvil[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]The anvil gives the possibility to the player to repair not just armor but also normal weapons, which now have [b]durabilities[/b].[/p][p align="justify"]Weapons durability goes down when you hit something or use the weapon in case of glock, ak and crossbow. 
The main story weapons which are found around the map are not destroyed when their durability is at 0, they are just not usable anymore, until they are repaired. Craftable or findable weapons like the handmade hammer or the hammer are destroyed when they reach 0.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Armors and weapons are now unstackable.[/b][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]The three types of armor added are:
[b]Leather armor[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]Bones armor[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]Metal armor[/b]
[/p][p align="justify"]Added a new weapon, the [b]nailed wood plank[/b], crafted from the build panel with wood plank, nails box and fabric.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Added a new trap:[b] Gas trap[/b][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]ARROWS:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]2 new types of arrows are coming to the game:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"][b]Burning arrow[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p align="justify"][b]Exploding arrow[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"]When reloading with the crossbow, it will automatically load the first arrow found in the inventory. If the player reloads again, it will try to load another type of arrow (if it is in the inventory).[/p][p align="justify"]In the UI the player can see which type of arrow he’s about to shoot.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]MINIMAP:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]After months you can now finally check your surroundings with a minimap while exploring the island and its secrets! [/p][p align="justify"][b]Open the map with M[/b] and check the [b]Points of Interests[/b], the infected zones and the terrain around you![/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]THE WASTELANDS:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]A new zone has been added to the game, the wastelands![/p][p align="justify"]After the first explosion, radiation seeped deep into the earth, only to surge back out through geysers, transforming the palm beaches and oasis in a blistering, arid zone.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]In this new area there is a new type of tree: the [b]mutated palm[/b]. The palm wood is too strong to be cut down but when the player hits the trees, he can shake them and make goop fruits fall from them![/p][p align="justify"]The water was intoxicated and turned into this greenish color, also becoming unhealthy for humans.[/p][p align="justify"]New locations were also added in this zone.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]ITEMS ADDED:[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]Goop fruit[/b]: obtained by hitting the palm trees, and the fruit will fall to the ground.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Cactus pulp[/b]: obtainable from cactuses in the desert.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Wax[/b]: obtainable from beehives findable on top of trees. To destroy a beehive, shoot it or hit it with a weapon. Another way is to chop down the tree, the beehive will automatically be destroyed and drop wax. [/p][p align="justify"][b]Putrid paste[/b]: a strong glue made out of goop fruits and wax usable for repairing tools and weapons.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Charcoal[/b]: obtainable by cooking in a grill wood.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Bones[/b]: dropped by dead zombies after decomposing with skulls. They are usable to craft some things.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Leather[/b]: obtainable from dead horses and dead deer.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Electrical wire[/b]: used in some recipes, obtainable in chests.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Gun cleaning kit[/b]: obtainable in chests, used in repairing guns.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Cactus energy drink[/b]: a strong energy drink made with water and cactus pulp.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Improvised handsaw[/b]: a craftable handsaw usable as an alternative to the normal handsaw.
[/p][p align="justify"][b]WILD LIFE:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Living animals have been finally added to the game, which gives the player the ability to hunt them, collecting leather and meat.[/p][p align="justify"]Animals will spawn only in determined zones and in few quantities.[/p][p align="justify"]The added animals are:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Deers[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Horses
[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"][b]FLASHLIGHTS:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]A flashlight slot has now been added in the inventory, with new types of flashlights and torches joining the game, both craftable and findable.[/p][p align="justify"]The new flashlights and torches added are:
[b]Torch: [/b]crafted with stick, charcoal, fabric and wax, gives the player a lot of light with a big flame.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Bottle candle: [/b]crafted with an empty glass bottle and some wax, small light but lasts almost forever.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]NEW STRUCTURES:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Some new structures were added:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Leather bed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]NEW POINTS OF INTEREST:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Various locations have been added to the game, new house complexes, an entire road going through the map, a bridge, a couple of small shops, 3 warehouses and small POIs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]General Fixes:[/b][/p][p]I reworked the way tools are needed for building and crafting. Now multiple tools can be used to craft something, for example before this update crafting a rope would need a hunting hatchet, but it made sense that if you can build it with a hunting hatchet you should be able to use a fire axe too. So now the rope can be built with the hunting hutchet or the fire axe. Same thing for other recipes and buildings with all the tools.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]After a lot of time and work I could finally put my hands on the extremely intricate and bad system I first made for the [b]cooking[/b] and rework it to get rid of every bug (I hope). Now the player can cook multiple foods with different grills at the same time, there should not be any more bugs about food despawning or glitching in the display.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Fixed AK47 having a shadow.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed AK47 name and description.[/p][p align="justify"]As often requested I modified some values in the day/night cycle. Now the day lasts for about 10 minutes while the night is slightly sped up to last about 5 minutes. This guarantees a better experience during the day and less frustration in night hours.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that would make the ak47 collectable multiple times without ever despawning.[/p][p align="justify"]The loot in chests now respawns every 7 days. This is done to make longer saves and gameplay possible without ever finishing resources.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed some broken colliders of powerpoles around the map.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Added a starting dying npc at the crash site to help the player start the game.[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Added an audio when refilling water containers.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed land mines, bear traps and skullcrusher not working with zombies.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Now the player can quickly move an item from the inventory to an empty hotbar slot by clicking left shift while left clicking on the item and vice versa from the hotbar to the inventory.[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Fixed the blood pool spawn when zombies die and slightly changed the scrapped zombies pool’s sizes.[/p][p align="justify"]Also added the outline effect to dead zombies when collecting fabric/metal scraps.[/p][p align="justify"]Now food and drink are automatically selected after consuming.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed the zombie despawn process that would not despawn any scrapped zombies and heavily impact performances.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Now if the player sleeps at any time at night he will wake up in the morning. If he sleeps during the day he will sleep for 8 hours and then wake up.[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Now in the cooking panel the name of the items is shown on top of each item when hovering them like in the building panel.[/p][p align="justify"]Changed the position of 1 of the 2 possible starting spawn points.[/p][p align="justify"]Modified some recipes with new items.[/p][p align="justify"]Reworked the main menu look.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that would let the player attack/shoot while drawing the weapon which would make it impossible to switch weapon/object in the hotbar.[/p][p align="justify"]Added audio to bear trap when activating.[/p][p align="justify"]Changed the effects of land mines explosions.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed a bug when collecting a weapon in the hotbar.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed the weather zone in the desert and added a new environmental audio.[/p][p align="justify"]The post processing setting is now automatically off at start.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed a bug when crafting items with inventory full.[/p][p align="justify"]When the player opens the panel now the arms are hidden temporarily.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed a bug when filling containers with full inventory.[/p][p align="justify"][b]Improved performances for higher fps.[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that would destroy boxes when reloading guns with a full inventory.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed a bug in the cooking panel that would let the player place an item in the middle of the screen without an actual slot.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed a bug when collecting items from the ground directly in the hotbar.[/p][p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that would destroy guns from player’s hands when reloading with only hotbar slots available for ammos.[/p][p align="justify"]Reworked some spawn values for consumables.[/p][p align="justify"]Drinking alcoholic beverages now makes the player more tired.[/p][p][/p][p]This update took me a lot of time and I am really happy with the state of the game right now, I hope you can enjoy it and love it as much as I do :)[/p][p]Thanks[/p][p][/p][p]Alessandro Bettini[/p]

notes.title: Patch v.03
notes.notes:
Small patch with some upgrades today!

[h3]AK47![/h3]
After a long time the [b]AK47 [/b] was added back in the game!
Find the AK47 hidden somewhere in the world and shoot your way through hordes of zombies like you’ve never done!

[h3]Refillable Containers![/h3]
[b]Empty containers can now be filled with water from rivers, lakes and ponds.[/b]
Fillable containers:
Empty bottle turns into a water bottle.
Empty glass bottle turns into a glass water bottle.
Empty jug turns into a water jug.

Added the new item [i]Glass water bottle[/i].

[h3]General Fixes:[/h3]
Fixed some doors not opening in the city.
Fixed a flying abandoned camp in the forest near the desert.
[b]Reduced some utils and weapons recipes build times.[/b]
Fixed a bug that made it impossible to hit zombies in the head with arrows.
Added UI sounds when inspecting and moving items in inventory, chests and cooking panels.
Modified some lighting and weather values for a more cohesive atmosphere.

As always thank you everybody for the support :)

[b]Now the chest panel and the cooking panel are closable while using them by reclicking E or the designed interact key.[/b]
Fixed a bug that would show the blood panel when exiting from underwater even if no damage was taken.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes: Fixed a bug from last update, compass would not show.

notes.title: Zombies and general fixes patch
notes.notes:
Hi everybody, with today's update I made some important fixes of bugs that were in the game since the start and some important additions.
I worked on the zombies and I am slowly getting to have them be a bit better, update after update.
I strongly agree to make a new saving because with old ones there could be a problem with the chests loot.

[h3]Zombie movement and combat update 🧟:[/h3]
Zombies have been reworked for better hitboxes and hits.
Now the player can hit from a little more distant, successfully hitting the zombies.
This new method for tracking hit and hitboxes is being tested with this update so it is not perfect nor definitive, but I consider it a good progress from the previous bugged hitboxes.
[b]Now zombies should not spawn on roofs again.[/b]
Zombies now rotate before hitting a player in order to look at him (still to be perfectioned).

[h3]Important Fixes 🛠️:[/h3]
[b]Fixed a bug that was there since first release of the player slowly slipping away when staying still on terrain or on objects, now it stays still correctly and doesn’t slip away anymore.[/b]
[b]Now the build panel allows you to craft more items with just one click, set the number of items you want to craft and once you click build all you’ll have to do is wait for the building to end![/b]
[i]Added a setting to set on/off the head bobbing.[/i]

[h3]General Fixes 🛠️:[/h3]
Changed crossbow reload time from 1 second to 2.5 seconds.
[i]Now players can drink and refill their canteen from wells around the map.[/i]
Fixed colliders on containers in the junkyard.
Reduced the amount of life the sterilized bandage heals.
Changed the compass name and description.
Changed the pack of cigarettes item into a single cigarette item.
[b]Added a sound to the crossbow when shooting an arrow.[/b]
Fixed arrow collider for recollecting it after shooting.
[i]Fixed a bug that would show a white box instead of the item picture when opening inventory.[/i]
[i]Now arrows can be recollected from dead zombies killed with them too.[/i]
Changed arrow recipe to 1 stick and 1 metal scrap instead of 2.
[b]Added a new POI in the woods, a small farm.[/b]

Thank you, hope you'll enjoy this update, see you at the next one in a few days.

notes.title: Important bug Fixes and new Object
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, with today's update there are some main fixes to mechanics and UIs and a new palceable object.

[h3]New structure and object added, the Sleeping bag![/h3]
Find the sleeping bag around the world and place it wherever you want to sleep at any moment!
Then pick it up and bring it with you on your exploration!

[h3]General Fixes:[/h3]
[b]Lowered fatigue multiplier, now fatigue goes down slower.[/b]
Fixed door animation not working in certain doors.
Fixed the starting spawn in the inventory of the water canteen, the compass and the flashlight.
Fixed sleep multiplier.
[i]Fixed volume settings not loading correctly in the main menu.[/i]
[b]Fixed empty canteen not refilling when trying to refill in rivers/lakes.[/b]
[b]Added walking and running sound for when the player is on roads and in buildings.
Players can now switch items in the hotbar using the mouse wheel.[/b]
Fixed bugged spawn of rocks and dead animals.
Fixed bug on zombie spawning.
[b]Modified zombie spawns values for better realism, still working on this to perfection.[/b]
Added a UI element that shows the name of the items needed for a recipe in the building panel.
[i]Changed inventory base key to TAB.[/i]
Fixed key bindings settings not getting saved correctly.
[b]The game now runs in the background.[/b]

Thanks.

notes.title: Small Patch

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi everyone, some fixes for the last update:[/h3]

notes.title: Weekly Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Added new types of structures: Traps![/h3]

Protect your base with [b]land mines and heavy land mines[/b], you will not have to worry about zombies anymore!
Craft them from the build panel, under the weapons category, and place them wherever you want!
But watch your steps, because they are not only for zombies! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268699/4b0ebd4ebd0c5bd3c2736fb23ae01d36178129c1.png[/img]

[b]In a land with no bears, bear traps still find a use![/b] Place them near your base and trap the first zombie that walks on it! Immobilize him and kill him easily with no risks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268699/4d58c4463b74cecdc7c628347319ee587c5f0a9e.png[/img]

No more worries about zombies wandering around your house, [b]the skull crusher[/b] will take care of that! Wait for a zombie to walk under it and let the skullcrusher do what its name says!
This powerful trap is perfect for luring zombies and killing them without having to fight and risk your life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268699/0ed13f592f26f8a7a8d4c05fade9b0f70164e40b.png[/img]

[h3]New items:[/h3]
[b]The skull![/b] The skull is a new item spawned from the decomposed zombies. After dying zombies will start decomposing and at the end of the process a collectable skull will spawn at their place. The skull is used in crafting structures like the brand new Skull Spike and new uses will be added with future updates (traps and weapons).

[h3]General Fixes:[/h3]
Fixed zombie saving file problem,[i] now zombies are saved correctly [/i]in positions and numbers.
Fixed some weapons colliders and shadows.
Changed recipe of the spikes defences reducing the necessary logs from 10 to 5.
[i]The yarn item was removed to be switched with the new rope item, simply for more sensed craftings and items.[/i]

notes.title: April Fool's Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Zombie and Combat mini-update[/h3]

First of all sorry everyone for the time that has passed from the last update, I have been away and couldn't work on the game for about a week.
Anyway this is all this update adds to the game:

[b]Flashlight is now kept on the left hand[/b], allowing the player to use it while also using one handed weapons or compasses. [i]Flashlight is no longer equipped from the hotbar but from clicking F[/i] while having it in inventory.
[i]Added a small light to the compass to make it visible at night.[/i]
Added [i]combos to weapons[/i], players can now make a 2 attacks combo with every weapon.
Updated main menu UI.
Upgraded both zombies and player attacks. Zombies can now hit the player more easily than before and they will stop the attack they were charging if hit. 
Upgraded also the[i] zombie movement[/i] in the map and their wandering.
Updated controls UI in settings.
[b]Zombies now avoid structures built by the player like walls and furniture, finally.[/b]

General Fixes:
Fixed shadows of some weapons/objects.
Fixed UI bug when loading/deleting old games from main menu.
When refilling the canteen with water it will disappear from the hand leaving empty hands.
[i]Fixed a bug in the tutorial where trees would never fall.[/i]
Added missing errors in tutorial.
Fixed arms bug in tutorial and fast build panel bug.
Added missing audios in the tutorial.
After recharging the flashlight it now turns on automatically.

notes.title: Lighting and Weather Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]A brand new lighting, weather system and day/night cycle is coming in Apocalypse Island with this huge update!
[/h2]

[previewyoutube=3tw7Y5S4ewk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Implemented Enviro3 in the game to make all the next features:[/b]
New day/night cycle,
New weather system with 6 different possible weather types: sunny, 3 shades of cloudy, rain and storms (with lightnings!),
New lighting approach to the entire scene,
New environmental audios.

Added a new structure called the covered campfire, allowing players to use campfires even with rain or storm.

Normal campfires can now not be used when there is rain or storm.

[h3]Added a new starting object, the flashlight! 🔦
[/h3]

[h3]General Fixes:[/h3]
Added new UI for error when trying to interact with a campfire while it is raining.
Changed min sleepless value in order to sleep from 55% to 40%.
Changed multiplier values of thirst, hunger and sleep.
[b]Fixed an error that made reloading the glock impossible.[/b]
Added some glowing eyes to the zombies to make them easier to be seen during nighttime.
Fixed graphical bugs in some buildings.
Small changes to the military base and to the north coast.
Fixed colliders of all tree roots.
[i]Added a new recipe to craft yarn from fabric.
Fabric can now be obtained from dead zombies.[/i]
[b]Changed interacting button from X to E.[/b]
[b]Players can now fast move items from chest to inventory and vice versa by clicking left shift when right clicking with the mouse on the item.[/b]
Players can now close all options panels by clicking ESC.
Fixed a bug that wouldn’t save items inside chests placed by the player.
Added new roads and [b]2 new POI’s.[/b]
